headline: Two 10-1 Beatdowns Open Week Two
subhead: theInfamous and Adam Silver Dez Nuts each took Monday 10-1, while Anthony Edwards dropped 47 and only bought BrookynDynasty a 5-5 tie.

zingers.line: Nova Knicks opened Week 2 by losing the night 10-1 to theInfamous, the worst night in the league.
Thug Life got 7 turnovers from LaMelo Ball and one category off Adam Silver Dez Nuts, losing the night 1-10.
Naz Reid went 8 for 22 and White Mambas limped out of Monday down 8-2 to Suggs to be you.
Acinonyx led the league with 9 turnovers and already trails LeParth James 8-3 after one night.
Zero Fox Given won the night with 24 threes and 55 assists and still only split 5-5 with BrookynDynasty.
MONSTARS ☄️ watched Payton Pritchard drain 7 threes for Gopher Gold and fell behind 7-3 on night one.
Anthony Edwards dropped 47 for BrookynDynasty and the reward was a 5-5 tie with Zero Fox Given.

night: Alperen Şengün posted 29 points, 9 rebounds, 9 assists and 6 steals for Adam Silver Dez Nuts, the best line of the night.
LaMelo Ball coughed up 7 turnovers and went 0 for 2 at the line for Thug Life, the worst brick of the night in a 1-10 loss.
Rudy Gobert grabbed 20 rebounds for Suggs to be you and went 0 for 9 from the field doing it.
Mo Bamba scored 14 with 4 blocks on 7 for 8 shooting and is still sitting on the wire.
Suggs to be you had the best night in the league, leading White Mambas 8-2 behind 39 points from Brandon Miller.
